sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Teach early acceleration out of a long rising bowl exit.
Read a longer takeoff and descending catch before the loop approach.
Settle the suspension before entering the boost branch.
Use two connector boosts to support a tall optional inversion and visible ground return.
Separate the loop speed regime from the later manual gap.
Use a descending high line to rebuild readable forward flow.
A long visible manual crossing with a wide catch is the final exam after full recovery.
One final reward marks the calm roller cooldown.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
